description: Sample configuration for Agent Registry Automation. Customize values for your environment.

zone1.label: Personal Productivity
zone1.description: Inventory only — agents are discovered and tracked but no approval gate is enforced

zone2.label: Team/Departmental
zone2.description: Registration required before sharing — agents must be registered but do not require committee approval

zone3.label: Enterprise/Customer-Facing
zone3.description: Registration and committee approval required — unregistered agents are auto-quarantined

slaConfiguration.description: SLA applies to registration approval requests. Escalation triggers when the deadline is exceeded.

scanConfiguration.description: Controls how frequently discovery and orphan detection scans run

entraSync.description: Feature-flagged sync to Entra Agent Registry. Enable only after confirming API availability.

notifications.description: Configure notification recipients for discovery alerts, approval requests, and orphan reports

retention.description: 2555 days = approximately 7 years, supporting SEC 17a-3/4 retention requirements
